publication: Exact commit, deployment and HTTP identity are recorded in the matching .release-gate/living-road/FINISH-016-*/publication.json receipt. This report alone is not deployment confirmation.
publication_tooling: The first wrapper attempt stopped before commit/push on Vercel settings API HTTP 403. GitHub confirmed the existing main Git deployment succeeded and the live manifest remained reachable. Git-only publication now leaves hosting settings untouched, captures the previous live manifest, binds artifacts locally and confirms delivery through Git status and public HTTP hashes; no credential or provider failure is represented as successful deployment.
root_cause: Selected environment OBJ/MTL source references lacked exported Texture2D import/remap payloads. Parent resources could load with incomplete materials without blocking opening readiness.
repair: Compile environment material dependencies from selected resources and OBJ material libraries.
Select all 32 required environment texture imports explicitly in their single owning opening pack.
Validate decoded texture leaves before opening or selected Continue constructs material parents.
Keep failed preflight state sticky until Retry; release only owned requests and retain valid cached resources.
Defer old-catalog validation until regeneration and retire only exact obsolete generated selections.

evidence_reuse: Runtime and isolated texture checks used the first candidate. The r2 correction changes only three approved music streams and resulting pack/root identities; environment texture payloads, dependency ledger, runtime code, input and save dependencies are unchanged. Those passed checks are retained at that scope, not represented as an r2 replay or audio listening approval.
check_corrections: Initial new isolated verifier had a typed-Variant syntax issue; corrected before baseline/candidate results.
Export-log ownership parser initially retained ANSI colour suffixes and reported empty matches; normalized log control codes, then all 32 passed.
One browser-control timeout during Quality reload required reconnecting to the same tab; no new journey or replacement candidate.

observations_not_benchmarks.note: Different stages and uncontrolled local browser conditions. Not end-to-end timing certification or a before/after speed claim.

package.note: Restored required assets increase the opening download. No content/texture-quality reduction. Decoded bytes are not process-memory evidence.

remaining_findings.finding: Changing Quality during paused gameplay leaves the loading overlay blocking Settings. Source transition advancement occurs after the paused-session return. Browser storage completed and a fresh reload/Continue worked. No change made under PACK-CLOSURE.
Opening download transfer floor alone exceeds the retained 15-second cold-control target; observed preparation remains slow. No FPS/memory/transition compliance claimed.
